index.html.popover #about-stateless: Candidate 1 of the report. The size includes the one-byte SHRINCS indicator.
index.html.popover #about-uxmss: Ranges go from the first to the last signature. Each signature carries one more 16-byte node than the one before, so size and SigVer grow while ρ and the cached SigGen fall.
index.html.popover #glossary: Glossary C One SHA-256 compression. Costs count compressions; the PK.seed block is compressed once per key and reused. B Byte. KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer Compressions to generate a key pair, to sign a message and to verify a signature. SigVer is the average unless marked worst. ρ SigVer per signature byte, in C/B. ρ ÷ Schnorr ρ divided by the ρ of a BIP340 Schnorr verification (libsecp256k1, 64-byte signature). SLH-DSA-128s The FIPS 205 parameter set (h, d, k, a, w) = (63, 7, 14, 12, 16). Ratios (×) compare against it. h, d, k, a, w Hypertree height, number of layers, FORS trees, FORS tree height, Winternitz parameter. h′ = h/d is the height of one layer. q s The number of signatures per key that security is computed for: 2 ^40 for the stateless schemes. WOTS, WOTS+C Winternitz one-time signatures. WOTS (as in SLH-DSA) has checksum chains; WOTS+C replaces them with a counter that the signer grinds until the message digits have a fixed sum, so verification always costs the same. XMSS, XMSS-MT, UXMSS Stateful schemes: one balanced Merkle tree (BXMSS in SHRINCS), d layers of such trees, and the unbalanced SHRINCS tree, whose signatures grow by one node per signature. Cached, cold A cached signer keeps tree state between signatures (a BDS state for XMSS, a leaf cache for UXMSS); a cold signer keeps none and rebuilds its trees for every signature.

stateful.html.popover #about-signer: A cached signer keeps tree state between signatures: a BDS state for XMSS and XMSS-MT, and a leaf cache for UXMSS. A cold signer keeps none and rebuilds its trees for every signature. SLH-DSA-128s is stateless, so its SigGen is the same in both modes.
stateful.html.popover #about-size: Sizes follow the SHRINCS stateful layout: a one-byte indicator, a 16-byte randomizer and the leaf index, then per layer the WOTS+C counter (2 bytes; 4 at w = 65536), the chains and the authentication path. UXMSS signatures grow by one 16-byte node per signature, so size and ρ show first → last. Ratios, bounds, sorting and SigVer use the largest signature.
stateful.html.popover #about-siggen: Cached: an upper bound per signature. For XMSS and XMSS-MT that is one BDS update per layer, at most (h′ − K)/2 + 1 leaf computations; for UXMSS it is the first signature, which combines the most nodes from the leaf cache. Cold: the trees are rebuilt for every signature.
stateful.html.popover #about-state: What a cached signer stores: all hsf + 1 leaf hashes for UXMSS, the BDS state bound for XMSS and XMSS-MT. Empty for SLH-DSA-128s and for a cold signer.
stateful.html.popover #about-schnorr: The average ρ divided by the ρ of a BIP340 Schnorr verification, 1.98 C/B (libsecp256k1, one 64-byte signature; bip340-vs-sha256 , built-in value, the live kappa.json did not load). SLH-DSA-128s has ρ = 0.2791 C/B, 0.141× Schnorr.
stateful.html.popover #about-sweep: XMSS and XMSS-MT with h = 10 to 40, d = 1 to 10 dividing h, WOTS or WOTS+C and w ∈ {16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 65536}, plus the 12 UXMSS variants, whose tree height is capped at hsf = 255. Only candidates smaller than SLH-DSA-128s are listed.

XMSS, XMSS-MT, UXMSS Stateful schemes: one balanced Merkle tree (BXMSS in SHRINCS), d layers of such trees, and the unbalanced SHRINCS tree, whose signatures grow by one node per signature. Cached, cold A cached signer keeps tree state between signatures (a BDS state for XMSS, a leaf cache for UXMSS); a cold signer keeps none and rebuilds its trees for every signature.

stateful.html#cand=uxmss-WC-64,xmssmt-WC.popover #about-signer: A cached signer keeps tree state between signatures: a BDS state for XMSS and XMSS-MT, and a leaf cache for UXMSS. A cold signer keeps none and rebuilds its trees for every signature. SLH-DSA-128s is stateless, so its SigGen is the same in both modes.
stateful.html#cand=uxmss-WC-64,xmssmt-WC.popover #about-size: Sizes follow the SHRINCS stateful layout: a one-byte indicator, a 16-byte randomizer and the leaf index, then per layer the WOTS+C counter (2 bytes; 4 at w = 65536), the chains and the authentication path. UXMSS signatures grow by one 16-byte node per signature, so size and ρ show first → last. Ratios, bounds, sorting and SigVer use the largest signature.
stateful.html#cand=uxmss-WC-64,xmssmt-WC.popover #about-siggen: Cached: an upper bound per signature. For XMSS and XMSS-MT that is one BDS update per layer, at most (h′ − K)/2 + 1 leaf computations; for UXMSS it is the first signature, which combines the most nodes from the leaf cache. Cold: the trees are rebuilt for every signature.
stateful.html#cand=uxmss-WC-64,xmssmt-WC.popover #about-state: What a cached signer stores: all hsf + 1 leaf hashes for UXMSS, the BDS state bound for XMSS and XMSS-MT. Empty for SLH-DSA-128s and for a cold signer.
stateful.html#cand=uxmss-WC-64,xmssmt-WC.popover #about-schnorr: The average ρ divided by the ρ of a BIP340 Schnorr verification, 1.98 C/B (libsecp256k1, one 64-byte signature; bip340-vs-sha256 , built-in value, the live kappa.json did not load). SLH-DSA-128s has ρ = 0.2791 C/B, 0.141× Schnorr.
stateful.html#cand=uxmss-WC-64,xmssmt-WC.popover #about-sweep: XMSS and XMSS-MT with h = 10 to 40, d = 1 to 10 dividing h, WOTS or WOTS+C and w ∈ {16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 65536}, plus the 12 UXMSS variants, whose tree height is capped at hsf = 255. Only candidates smaller than SLH-DSA-128s are listed.
stateful.html#cand=uxmss-WC-64,xmssmt-WC.popover #glossary: Glossary C One SHA-256 compression. Costs count compressions; the PK.seed block is compressed once per key and reused. B Byte. KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer Compressions to generate a key pair, to sign a message and to verify a signature. SigVer is the average unless marked worst. ρ SigVer per signature byte, in C/B. ρ ÷ Schnorr ρ divided by the ρ of a BIP340 Schnorr verification (libsecp256k1, 64-byte signature). SLH-DSA-128s The FIPS 205 parameter set (h, d, k, a, w) = (63, 7, 14, 12, 16). Ratios (×) compare against it. h, d, k, a, w Hypertree height, number of layers, FORS trees, FORS tree height, Winternitz parameter. h′ = h/d is the height of one layer. q s The number of signatures per key that security is computed for: 2 ^40 for the stateless schemes.
